title: Upperman High School
subtitle: NYC March 22-26, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Upperman High School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel Day to  NYC

  • Travel to NYC!
  • Lunch and Dinner stops en route to NYC
  • Check-in to Hotel Accommodations with overnight security (four nights)
 

Day 2: 9/11 Memorial Museum & Brooklyn Bridge

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Ferry to Visit Liberty Island and Ellis Island
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the 9/11 Memorial Museum
  • Tour Director Walking Tour of Lower Manhattan: Trinity Church, Wall Street, 9/11 Memorial Visit, Chinatown Little Italy 
  • Tour Director Led Walking Tour Across the Brooklyn Bridge
  • Group Exploration of the DUMBO Neighborhood 
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
 

Day 3: Central Park & Radio City Music Hall

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Tour Director Led Midtown Walking Tour: Rockefeller center, St Patrick’s Cathedral, Times Square, Grand Central Terminal
  • Picnic in Central Park
  • Tour Director Led Walking Tour of Central Park
  • Guided Tour of Radio City Music Hall
  • Dinner Allocation 
  • Group Exploration of Times Square
  • Visit the Empire State Building 
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 4: Madison Square Garden and Broadway Show

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Whitney Museum of American Art 
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Group Exploration of Chelsea Market, Hudson Yards, and The High Line
  • Guided Tour of Madison Square Garden
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Watch a Broadway Show
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 5: Departure for Home

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Departure for Home
introHeading: Upperman High School, get ready for an unforgettable NYC adventure in 2027! 🗽🏛️
introText: From iconic landmarks to world-famous neighborhoods, this New York City experience brings history, culture, and creativity to life at every turn. Students will visit Liberty and Ellis Island, reflect at the 9/11 Memorial, explore Lower Manhattan, and take in breathtaking views from the Empire State Building. With guided walks through Midtown and Central Park, time in vibrant areas like Times Square, and the excitement of a Broadway show, this trip offers the perfect blend of learning, culture, and unforgettable city energy.
